    Before you reach out

    Quick answers.

    How soon can we start?

    Usually within days of the discovery call. We confirm scope, sign the NDA and match your specialist, then start with a short trial task.

    Do you sign NDAs before the call?

    Yes. Mention it in your message and we will send our mutual NDA before we discuss anything confidential.

    Is there a minimum contract?

    Engagement terms are flexible and agreed in writing. We will explain the options clearly on the call — no pressure, no lock-in surprises.
